run_perturb_systems_main: run the main function to rattle relaxation pathway images at 5 variances and generate VASP input directories
create_rattled_structures: create rattled atomic structures from ASE trajectory images using configurable standard deviation values
generate_vasp_input_dirs: generate VASP calculation directories with POSCAR, KPOINTS, POTCAR, and SLURM submission scripts
read_ase_trajectory: read an ASE trajectory file and enumerate all images along a relaxation pathway
write_vasp_poscar: write a rattled atomic structure to a VASP POSCAR file using ase.io.write
